steps.name: Run native C and Rust probes
Build and test the API comparison tool
Compare APIs and all complete C record layouts
Compile and run the real zstd Rust consumer
Run zstd's unchanged binding build script
Compile and run the real SQLite Rust consumer
Check generated bindings and the consumer with Rust 1.64
Upload native evidence and build logs

limitations: The API gate accepts 262 named and justified differences. exact_equivalence is false; this is not a claim of identical generated Rust APIs.
The complete-C-translation-unit step was skipped in this macOS workflow. Header/body features exercised by workspace tests do not establish full real-project translation-unit coverage on macOS.

Rust 1.96 and lint jobs were skipped as Ubuntu-only jobs in this invocation; the native corpus frontend and consumers used Rust 1.96.0, and explicit generated-code compatibility tests used Rust 1.64.0.
Workspace test counts include nested harness executions and are not unique test counts. The all-features pass left 257 tests ignored; the separate include-ignored pass reported zero ignored tests.
No Intel macOS runner was used. Cross-target cases inside Apple Silicon tests do not constitute native Intel coverage.
No full uv or ty application build, end-user execution, or macOS performance benchmark is established by this artifact.
Tool executable, sysroot/header, and upstream source hashes in the artifact are runner-recorded. The tool executables and complete sysroot/source trees are not included for local rehashing.
